en: Changed MCP tools so a tool that sets its own `_meta['anthropic/alwaysLoad']` to false stays deferred when its `--mcp-config`, Agent SDK or plugin server is set to `alwaysLoad`
zh: 变更 MCP 工具行为：当某个工具将自身的 `_meta['anthropic/alwaysLoad']` 设为 false 时，即使其 `--mcp-config`、Agent SDK 或 plugin server 设置为 `alwaysLoad`，该工具仍保持延迟加载
